years.y1994:
It all began with a small oven and a dream.
Today Deya is one of the leaders of Uzbekistan's confectionery industry, with a taste known and loved in many countries.
In 30 years we have gone from 12 m² to an international brand, keeping what matters most — soul, warmth and a commitment to quality.
